ThemeLayout & style

The `m3e-theme` component — strict per-component surface.

import M3e
import M3e.Values
These helpers are our examples, not the library

The Doc.* helpers in these examples are this docs app's own module — not part of elm-m3e (they won't resolve from a fresh install). You rarely need anything like them. The library gives you typed components (M3e.*) plus TypedHtml for standard HTML, and you never import HtmlIr: M3e.Element, M3e.Attr, M3e.Node, M3e.Values.Value and M3e.Kind.Supported / .Shared are all re-exported, so every type annotation you need is reachable from the brand. Build layout, text, and links directly from those. The genuine escapes ship with the library too, in one greppable, lint-fenced place — M3e.Unsafe (fromHtml, fromNode, recast, and customElement for a custom tag the types can't express) and M3e.Unsafe.Attributes. See Escapes.

]

]

]
]

el is identical to the M3e tab for this example — its content has no required slots or attributes for the el surface to enforce, so it would be a hollow duplicate of M3e. Reach for el on an example whose composition it can hold a guarantee over.

[ M3e.Theme.build
|> M3e.Theme.withStrongFocus True
|> M3e.Theme.withMotion M3e.Values.standard
|> M3e.Theme.withChild
(Native.node "label"
[]
[ Kit.text "Standard"
, M3e.Switch.view [] []
]
)
|> M3e.Theme.toElement
, M3e.Theme.build
|> M3e.Theme.withStrongFocus True
|> M3e.Theme.withMotion M3e.Values.expressive
|> M3e.Theme.withChild
(Native.node "label"
[]
[ Kit.text "Expressive"
, M3e.Switch.view [] []
]
)
|> M3e.Theme.toElement
]

API

Constructor

view : List.List (HtmlIr.Attribute.Attr M3e.Component.Theme.Attrs msg) -> List.List (HtmlIr.Element.Element childAccepts (M3e.Component.Theme.ChildAdmittedBy childAdm) msg) -> HtmlIr.Element.Element (M3e.Component.Theme.Is s) admittedBy msg

Standard constructor: [attributes] [children]. The default slot is kind-permissive (any): children of any kind compose, but each child's OWN admittedBy must still admit this context — a restricted-parent element is rejected here at compile time.

type Is

The kind row m3e-theme produces (open — composes into any slot naming it).

type Attrs

The closed attribute-capability row.

type Builder

The narrowed pipe-builder this component's M3e.Build.<X> module exposes.

type AttrCaps

The attribute capabilities this component's builder admits.

type SlotCaps

The singular-slot capabilities this component's builder admits.

type ChildAdmittedBy

The context demand this container injects into each child's admittedBy row.

type Contrast

The contrast values valid on this component (compile-tight narrowing).

type Motion

The motion values valid on this component (compile-tight narrowing).

type Scheme

The scheme values valid on this component (compile-tight narrowing).

type Variant

The variant values valid on this component (compile-tight narrowing).

Other

contrast : HtmlIr.Value.Value M3e.Component.Theme.Contrast -> HtmlIr.Attribute.Attr { c | contrast : HtmlIr.Kind.Supported } msg

The contrast level of the theme. (default: "standard")

motion : HtmlIr.Value.Value M3e.Component.Theme.Motion -> HtmlIr.Attribute.Attr { c | motion : HtmlIr.Kind.Supported } msg

The motion scheme. (default: "standard")

scheme : HtmlIr.Value.Value M3e.Component.Theme.Scheme -> HtmlIr.Attribute.Attr { c | scheme : HtmlIr.Kind.Supported } msg

The color scheme of the theme. (default: "auto")

variant : HtmlIr.Value.Value M3e.Component.Theme.Variant -> HtmlIr.Attribute.Attr { c | variant : HtmlIr.Kind.Supported } msg

The color variant of the theme. (default: "neutral")

color : String.String -> HtmlIr.Attribute.Attr { c | color : HtmlIr.Kind.Supported } msg

See M3e.Attributes.color.

density : Basics.Float -> HtmlIr.Attribute.Attr { c | density : HtmlIr.Kind.Supported } msg

See M3e.Attributes.density.

strongFocus : Basics.Bool -> HtmlIr.Attribute.Attr { c | strongFocus : HtmlIr.Kind.Supported } msg

See M3e.Attributes.strongFocus.

onChange : msg -> HtmlIr.Attribute.Attr { c | onChange : HtmlIr.Kind.Supported } msg

See M3e.Events.onChange.

child : HtmlIr.Element.Element childAccepts admittedBy msg -> HtmlIr.Element.Element free freeAdmittedBy msg

Place a pre-built element into the default (unnamed) slot (input constrained to the slot's kinds; output row free so it composes into the child list). The list-form sibling of the builder's withChild.
